source_title: Massachusetts 700 CMR 7.07 — Special Limitations and Issuance of Special Permits (MassDOT Highway Division)
verify_reasons: Width/length escort matrix, State Police triggers (over 16' wide or over 135' long = 2 MSP vehicles), superload (>130,000 lbs) and the permit fee table are read from 700 CMR 7.07. The height-escort thresholds (high-pole + route survey over ~13'8"/13'6"; 2 civilian + State Police over 14'11") are cross-referenced from published MassDOT permit summaries rather than the CMR text — confirm the exact tall-load escort/route-survey configuration with the MassDOT Permit Office.

superload_thresholds.note: Loads over 130,000 lbs gross require an engineering survey and are issued as a superload single-trip ($300, 700 CMR 7.07 Table 5). Loads wider than 16' or longer than 135' must be escorted by two Massachusetts State Police vehicles. Height superload threshold not fixed numerically in the CMR — tall loads route-surveyed case-by-case.

width.note: following pilot car for width over 12' up to 13'6" (700 CMR 7.07)
preceding + following pilot cars for width over 13'6" up to 16' (700 CMR 7.07)
two Massachusetts State Police vehicles required over 16' wide (700 CMR 7.07)

height.note: high-pole escort + route survey for tall loads (per MassDOT permit summaries — confirm exact threshold)
two civilian escorts + Massachusetts State Police over 14'11" high (per MassDOT permit summaries — confirm)

length.note: following pilot car, ~90'-100' overall length (700 CMR 7.07)
preceding + following pilot cars, over 100' up to 135' (700 CMR 7.07)
two Massachusetts State Police vehicles required over 135' long (700 CMR 7.07)

single_trip.fee_formula: Irreducible-load single trip = $40 (or $400/year annual). Reducible-load overweight permit = $50 per 1,000 lbs exceeding the Federal Bridge Formula. Superload (>130,000 lbs) single trip = $300 (700 CMR 7.07 Table 5).
single_trip.note: Overweight above legal is Federal-Bridge-Formula driven; reducible-load fee scales per 1,000 lbs over the formula limit.

movement_restrictions: On the Massachusetts Turnpike, loads over 12' wide, over 100' long, or over 130,000 lbs gross require a State Police escort
On Cape Cod, loads over 12' wide require 1 pilot car plus a State Police escort
Tunnel movements (irreducible-load permits) restricted to one direction and subject to peak-hour tunnel restrictions
Daytime movement typical for over-dimensional loads; escorts maintain two-way radio contact
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; 53' semitrailer on the National Network.
Escort width/length matrix, State Police triggers, superload and fees read from 700 CMR 7.07; height-escort thresholds cross-referenced from published MassDOT summaries.
